body_html:
The Craft Rectangle Unit turns a lobby or breakout zone into a space people actually want to gather in. Part of Global's fully upholstered Craft modular lounge series, this non-handed rectangle pairs with five other seating shapes and five coordinating tables — so you can build casual meeting areas that flex as your space and headcount change. Built durable for high-traffic institutional settings and made in Canada.

Features

  • Fully upholstered modular rectangle unit from the Craft lounge series
  • Non-handed components reconfigure freely — ideal for open-plan and collaborative spaces
  • Geometric shapes combine for unique, near-infinite layout possibilities
  • Mixes interchangeably with other Craft seating shapes and tables
  • Standard 1.5" tall nylon glides; optional dual-wheel carpet (C107) or hard-floor (C107R) casters
  • Available in all Grade 1 seating textiles, Luxhide, graded-in, and GPM textiles
  • GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold certified for low-emission indoor air quality

Specifications

Overall 40"W x 20"D x 17.5"H with a 17.5" seat height and 2.5" seat foam. Weighs 37 lbs (16.8 kg). Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group under its Offices To Go line.

Office Central is a family-owned dealer (since 1964) based at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON, and an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. To confirm upholstery grades, pricing, or a full Craft configuration, Request a Quote or call 1-800-835-9565.
